p.s: Dear Mrs Brown,

We will have food and drink and we will have music because we know that Mr Brown loves music.
At the party will come his students, the teachers and the principal.
My last question is about present.
My fellow students have suggested to buy a CD or a Book.

I am looking forward to hearing from you as soon as possible.
Yours sincerely,
